 \\\\                           Version History                           \\\\
  \\\\_____________________________________________________________________\\\\
   ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

   * 1.00 - 01/17/2012 *
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 - The guide was finished and uploaded for the first time.


   * 1.01 - 01/19/2012 *
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 - The Special Skills section was added.
 - The Store/Shop List section was added.
 - The Acupuncturist Costs section was added.
 - The Lottery section was added.
 - The Malice Rewards Section was added.
 - The Pedometer Rewards Section was added.
 - The NPC Library section was added.
 - The Sub-bosses and Bosses section was added.

   * 1.02 - 01/20/2012 *
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 - The Game Manual / Instructions section was added.
 - The Codebreaker Codes section was added.


   * 1.03 - 01/23/2012 *
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 - The Weapons section was added.
 - The Monster Library (Bestiary) section was added.
 - The Gameshark Codes section was added.
 - The Action Replay Max Codes section was added.
 - The Help (detailed, available in-game) section was added.
 - Corrected the Banshee and Larmgelg's Monster Library numbers.


   * 1.04 - 01/30/2012 *
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 - A complete redesign was done.
 - The Armor section was added.
 - The Accessories section was added.
 - The Souls section was added and merged with the Special Skills section.
 - The Items section was added.
 - The Valuables section was added.
 - The Plot Synopsis was added.
 - The Codebreaker Codes section was removed.
 - The Gameshark Codes section was removed.
 - The Action Replay Max Codes section was removed.

   * 1.05 - 02/15/2012 *
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 - Reformatted once again.
 - Enemy Formations were removed from the walkthrough, but can still be found
   in the bestiary.
